'''Quests''' is a game system in ''[[Graveyard Keeper 2]]''. Quests are the main way the story progresses and can unlock new game systems, [[locations]], and even [[technologies]]. Each quest has a [[Characters|main character]] and a reward, and usually consists of several steps.

Quests can be viewed in the '''Quest Log''', which displays the character associated with the quest, its name, and its description.
